title: 4K动态音乐壁纸《流浪地球》The Wandering Earth
description:
After watching the wandering earth, I was moved to tears! I can't help making wallpaper when I get home!! I'm Xiao duo. This is my first time to make dynamic wallpaper. I hope you like it!! About wallpaper tutorial, you can go to blibli search (wandering earth 4K wallpaper tutorial) to watch!

Americans shoot science fiction to abandon the earth and explore new human settlements, while Chinese people do not give up the earth and keep their home land... "Hope is the only way for us to go home"

... finally, it's our turn to look at the stars!



As the author, why didn't you remove the words "wandering the earth" in the upper left corner? First of all, I don't think these words are watermarks. These words are a very important part of this set of wallpaper. Without these words, this set of wallpaper will lose its soul. I like these words very much, and it's my principle not to remove them. First, this is a poster wallpaper, It was originally made to promote the film. I don't want to lose the original nature! So thank you for using the dynamic wallpaper I made twice. I also hope you can see the movie wandering the earth!



Update version 16 at 12:00 on February 27, 2019 - adjust the special effect speed of planetary generator nozzle, greatly increase the cloud movement speed, it looks faster and more obvious, and increase the lightning scattering light effect of music response level cloud above the wallpaper, which has a flashing effect with the music cloud!!



Update version 15 at 11:30 on February 21, 2019 - update: snow particle update, increase the depth of snow and snow map optimization!



Update version 14 at 17:30 on February 11, 2019 - update: detail optimization and cloud detail optimization!



Update version 13 at 11:30 on February 10, 2019 - update: update: cloud dynamic enhancement!!! Jupiter dynamic strengthening!!!! It seems that the movement is more obvious!!



Update version 12 at 1:30 a.m. on February 9, 2019 - update: mouse tailing optimization, the tailing track will not be so long, and the special effects of the mouse when playing music are added. Dragging the mouse when playing music will be like a meteor!!!!



Update version 11 at 1 a.m. on February 9, 2019 - update: add long-range planetary engine injection effect, medium range second engine music effect, and some detail optimization!!



Update version 10 at 11:00 p.m. on February 8, 2019 - adjustment and optimization of special effects of planetary engine nozzle particles, and the nozzle particles look more fast!!!!



Update version 9 at 2 a.m. on February 8, 2019 - add fireworks special effects!! There will be fireworks at the climax of music!!!



Update version 8 at 1 a.m. on February 8, 2019 - update!!!! Spring Festival 12 rings! Spring Festival 12 rings!! Greatly enhance the jet effect again!!! Now, with the high and low music tone, the planetary engine nozzle will have special effects to rush into the sky!!!!



Update version 7 at 5:30 p.m. on February 7, 2019 - add the special effect of mouse sliding track! Cloud effect optimization!



Update version 6 at 5:00 p.m. on February 7, 2019 - add planetary engine energy nozzle special effect and nozzle music special effect, which can change color with the music!!



Update version 5 at 2:00 p.m. on February 7, 2019 - add cloud effect above and optimize other detailed effects



On the afternoon of February 6, 2019, the 4th version was updated, the overall planetary engine support details and lighting effects were added, and the self-contained BGM was added



On February 6, 2019, we started to make wallpaper 123 version. No, it's just a forced version. Hey, hey



Original source: official poster of wandering earth film / Zhao Li

BGM source: Wandering earth Movie OST / start a new journey / a Kun
